name: kb
description: Read and write the persistent graph knowledge base — linked notes that survive across sessions and grow as you investigate a codebase. ALWAYS search before researching something from scratch: a prior session may already have answered it, with evidence. Actions: 'search', 'read', 'write', 'append' (grow an existing note — preferred for iterative research), 'links' (outgoing/backlinks/dangling), 'graph' (hubs, orphans, and the frontier of unwritten notes), 'experiment' (RUN a command in the bound repo and record the measured result with provenance — use this instead of writing down numbers you did not measure), and 'stale' (findings measured against code that has since changed).

title.description: Note title — the wikilink identity. Required for read/write/append/links.

content.description: Markdown body for write/append. Link to other notes with [[Their Title]]; linking generously is the point.

kind.description: Classification for a written note, e.g. research, decision, codebase, howto.

summary.description: One-line summary stored in frontmatter, shown in search results.

hypothesis.description: For action='experiment': what you expect to find and why. Recorded alongside the result so a later reader can judge whether the experiment answered it.

command.description: For action='experiment': the shell command to RUN in the bound repo's worktree. Its real output, exit code and duration are captured — you cannot record a result you did not measure.

links.description: Titles of related notes to link from an experiment, so findings connect instead of accumulating in isolation.
